narrative.overview: A mobile-only editorial learning interface on a pure-black screen. Large light-weight type, semantic line breaks, hairlines and deliberate whitespace replace decorative cards and simulated depth. The surrounding desktop canvas remains silver.
keyCharacteristics: Integrated week calendar and date pager
Closely related blue, mist and stone card tones
Compact library rows without repeated goals or filenames
Concise source, settings and confirmation flow
No persistent bottom navigation, profile control or floating Agent launcher

rules.name: The Contained Palette Rule
rules.body: Closely related blue, mist and stone tones are confined to independent Today goal cards; navigation and overlays remain neutral.

rules.name: The Reading First Rule
rules.body: Reading content never collapses below a comfortable measure to preserve side panels.

rules.name: The Semantic Break Rule
rules.body: Large titles break only at complete semantic units and use weight 350 or above for Chinese text.

rules.name: The Always Flat Rule
rules.body: All content uses tonal layering and hairlines; no state uses gradients, shadows, highlights or blur.

dos: Do expose one primary action and its reason.
Do preserve source and evidence context.
donts: Don't build a file manager, dashboard, global graph or standalone chat shell.
Don't use nested cards or decorative glass by default.
